title: Canary Analysis: Promote, Roll Back or Extend
hints: Judge each window on its own counts. Pooling every window so far dilutes a regression that starts late in the rollout.
Check the rules in order: abort, then minimum samples, then the two comparisons. An insufficient window leaves both streaks untouched.
Streaks are consecutive. A healthy window resets the failure streak, and a failing window resets the pass streak.
Stop at the first promote or rollback. Every window after that is never analyzed, so it does not appear in the timeline.
